app.name: MyMedia
app.tagline: Your photos and videos, organized in your Google Drive

auth.signInHint: MyMedia only talks to your own Google Drive. Nothing is stored on any other server.
auth.reconnectTitle: Google connection needs to be renewed
auth.reconnectText: Your work is kept and will continue after you reconnect.
auth.scopeDenied: MyMedia needs access to your Google Drive. Please sign in again and tick the Drive permission.
auth.popupBlocked: The Google window could not open. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
auth.configMissing: The app is not configured yet: the Google client ID is missing in config.json (see the setup guide).

setup.title: Welcome to MyMedia
setup.noRoot: No "{{name}}" folder was found in your Google Drive. MyMedia will create it.
setup.rootMissingText: The "{{name}}" folder was deleted or moved to the trash in Google Drive. Restore it from the Drive trash, or create a new one.

folders.deleteText_one: The folder and its {{count}} file go to the Google Drive trash. You can restore them from there for 30 days.
folders.deleteText_two: The folder and its {{count}} files go to the Google Drive trash. You can restore them from there for 30 days.
folders.deleteText_other: The folder and its {{count}} files go to the Google Drive trash. You can restore them from there for 30 days.
folders.exists: A folder with this name already exists here.

gallery.emptyHint: Add photos or videos to the "{{name}}" folder in Google Drive, then press “Load new files”.

sync.scanning: Reading your Drive folders… {{done}} files found

viewer.cannotPlay: This video cannot be played in this browser.
viewer.cannotShow: This photo format cannot be shown in full quality in this browser.
viewer.deleteText: The file goes to the Google Drive trash. You can restore it from there for 30 days.

settings.title: Settings
settings.rootFolderHint: Renaming changes the folder name in Google Drive.
settings.syncAutoHint: Checks when the app opens, then regularly while it is open.
settings.rescanHint: Only needed if something looks wrong.

errors.syncFailed: Loading from Google Drive failed. It will be retried.
errors.metaUnreadable: mymedia.json in your Drive cannot be read. It was not changed. Restore a previous version from Google Drive (right-click → Manage versions).

classify.introClassify: Media at the root of the main folder, or in a category without an album. Tap the suggested album to move the file there, or choose another one.
classify.introAuto: MyMedia moved these files by itself because it was confident. Check them: confirm, or choose the right album.
classify.noSuggestion: No suggestion yet (learning in progress, or not enough examples).
classify.keepHereHint: Leave this file where it is; no more suggestions for it.
classify.autoSetting: Move files automatically when MyMedia is confident
classify.autoSettingHint: Only to albums with at least 3 example photos. Below that, MyMedia only suggests.
classify.rebuildHint: Learning runs by itself in the background after each load.
classify.learningHint: MyMedia studies your photos to recognise new ones. Nothing leaves your device.

stats.title: Learning statistics
stats.overall: Overall accuracy: {{percent}} (each photo tested against all the others)
stats.fewHint: With fewer than 3 photos, an album only gets suggestions, never automatic moves.

skip.videoNotHere_one: {{count}} video: compress it on a computer (Chrome or Edge)
skip.videoNotHere_other: {{count}} videos: compress them on a computer (Chrome or Edge)
skip.format_one: {{count}} HEIC/PNG photo (conversion to JPEG is off)
skip.format_other: {{count}} HEIC/PNG photos (conversion to JPEG is off)

compress.background: You can close this window: compression continues in the background (progress at the top).
compress.autoHint: Files you already had stay as they are: use the Compress button on an album to compress them. Videos are compressed only on a computer.
compress.convert: Convert HEIC and PNG photos to JPEG
compress.videoHint: Video compression needs a computer with Chrome or Edge. On phones, videos wait until the app is opened on a computer.

keep.version: Replace it (Drive keeps the old version about 30 days)
keep.both: Keep it forever in the file’s version history

keepHint.version: Saves the most space. The original can be recovered for about 30 days: in Drive, right-click the file → File information → Manage versions.
keepHint.folder: The original is copied to MyMedia/_Originals/… before compression. No space is saved until you delete that folder.
keepHint.both: The original stays as an older version of the same file, without time limit. No space is saved.

compress.minGain: Keep the file unchanged if it saves less than
